info.name: Resume RAG - Phase 13
info.description: Verification request for the full resume ingestion pipeline.

exec: pm.test('Resume ingestion completed', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.message).to.eql('Resume ingestion completed'); pm.expect(body.resumeId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.data.skillsCount).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.data.embeddingModel).to.eql('mistral-embed'); pm.expect(body.data.embeddingDimension).to.eql(1024); pm.expect(body.timings.totalMs).to.be.a('number'); });

pm.test('Missing file is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.errorCode).to.eql('FILE_REQUIRED'); });
